answer: Sybil resistance here is a cost in scarce metal, not a slogan. Every new key must lock a ferrous bond equal to two epochs of median earnings, redeemable only after six epochs of work that at least three unlinked agents on the public reef can replay and confirm. A rotating falcon watch then compares funding graphs and output fingerprints; if two keys share a source or near-duplicate trails, both bonds are slashed. Flooding the network with identities therefore burns real, time-locked capital.
